Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Cramped
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

The veil between the living and the dead grows thin here.

Research: Fortune Telling. The hireling reads your fortune (casting bones, reading tea leaves, a tarokka reading, or the like), and you gain Heroic Inspiration. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a Long Rest.

Speak with Dead. After a Long Rest in your Séance Parlor, you can immediately cast Speak with Dead without a spell slot or Material components, targeting any deceased creature whose name you know, provided you have a piece of its remains (ashes, a bone) or an object important to it in life (a brooch, a signature weapon). It speaks through an implement of the parlor, such as a crystal ball or a spirit board.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
